adminToolsCard.title: Administrative tools
adminToolsCard.subtitle: Maintenance actions for the plant floor visual layout -- these do not affect permissions, users, or historical data.

clearLayoutPanel.title: Clear layout for WC LINEA
clearLayoutPanel.subtitle: Removes area assignment, on the visual map, only for staff on the WC LINEA (production lines + WC LINEA 0) so leaders can place them again from Personnel Registration. Quality, Training, Team Leader, Support, Cleaning, Manager, Supervisor, Accessories, and Palletizing are never affected by this button. It does not delete anyone or remove them from Personnel/search — only from the layout. Unlike releasing for today, this does not revert when the day changes.
clearLayoutPanel.resultBanner: {{total}} people were left without a location in the layout.
clearLayoutPanel.dialogConfirmText: All staff placed today by the historical snapshot in a WC LINEA will be left without an area on the visual map, permanently until someone reassigns them. Quality, Training, Team Leader, Support, Cleaning, Manager, Supervisor, Accessories, and Palletizing are not touched. This does not affect the Personnel module or search. Confirm?
clearLayoutPanel.toastNoneFound: There's currently no one placed by snapshot in the WC LINEA — Quality, Accessories, Palletizing, and the other support areas are never affected by this button.
clearLayoutPanel.toastSuccess: Layout cleared: {{total}} people were left without an area until reassigned.

restoreLayoutPanel.title: Restore layout for WC LINEA
restoreLayoutPanel.subtitle: Returns, on the visual map, all staff left without an area by "Clear layout" to their historical line from LAYOUT FFT.xlsx (without a made-up position/station within the line — the Excel file doesn't say who does which position). Never touches anyone who already has a real assignment made today from Personnel Registration.
restoreLayoutPanel.resultBanner: {{total}} people reappeared in their WC LINEA.
restoreLayoutPanel.dialogConfirmText: All staff removed from the WC LINEA will be placed again by their historical zone from LAYOUT FFT.xlsx, without a specific position assigned (it stays as "—" until a leader registers it for real). This does not affect anyone who already has a real assignment made today. Confirm?
restoreLayoutPanel.toastNoneFound: There's currently no one removed in the WC LINEA — nothing needs to be restored.
restoreLayoutPanel.toastSuccess: Layout restored: {{total}} people returned to their WC LINEA area.
